findings.mechanism: 06-finding-n-plus-1 — N+1 queries are not detectable by reading code alone; the loop calling `serialize_order` per order issues a separate statement per order, scaling queries with result size.
findings.remediation: Fetch all required order data in a single query (e.g., join line items) and pass the fully materialized objects to the serializer, or batch the serializer calls with a DataLoader‑style loader to eliminate per‑order queries.
findings.arithmetic: queries = 1 (list_for_customer) + N (serialize_order per order). For N=50 orders → queries = 1+50 = 51 queries per request.
